title: Launch coins. Just ask Grok.
blurb: Tell Grok a name and a ticker. Seconds later your coin is live on pump.fun.

parts.note: Cover image — goes in the cover slot at the very top, not in the body.

parts.html:
You already talk to Grok all day. Now it launches coins.

Say a name and a ticker. Seconds later it’s live on pump.fun.

One tap to plug in

Grab your link on Grokpad and add it to Grok. Done. That’s the whole setup.

Then just ask

“Launch Moon Cat, ticker MCAT.”

Grok writes the description, makes the picture and ships it. You don’t fill in a thing.

Then ask again
See a meme. Say the word. It’s live in seconds. Got another one? Say it again.

Just ask Grok.

grokpad.org
